en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a symmetrical manor house with a central pediment, two stories and a tiled roof, flanked by lower wings and rows of potted trees. The view is framed by large overhanging tree branches like a vignette. Handwritten text appears below the image, and there is printed or written text on the lower left that reads "Christineholm."
